# adonis-skills

> Agent-agnostic skills for coding agents (review loops, workflow gates, MCP setup, Git delivery, local environment audits). Each skill is `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`. Install with `npx skills add adonis0123/adonis-skills --skill <name>`, as a Claude Code plugin (`/plugin marketplace add Adonis0123/adonis-skills`), or as a Hermes tap (`hermes skills tap add adonis0123/adonis-skills`).

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Adonis0123/adonis-skills/blob/main/README.md): install per host, skill list, recommended third-party skills
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Adonis0123/adonis-skills/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repository rules, commands, skill authoring conventions
- [Web catalog](https://adonis-skills.vercel.app/): skill metadata and install commands

## Skills

- [skills/](https://github.com/Adonis0123/adonis-skills/tree/main/skills): one directory per public skill; frontmatter `name` equals the directory name
- [Claude Code marketplace manifest](https://github.com/Adonis0123/adonis-skills/blob/main/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json)
